NODA CoPilot is a game-changing AI-powered module built on the NODA Intelligent Platform - an advanced analytics and decision-support solution for energy and utility companies, as well as real estate owners. NODA CoPilot transforms complex operational data into clear, explainable insights that enable smarter maintenance, performance optimization, and strategic decision-making. More than dashboards or chatbots, NODA CoPilot reasons across physics, economics, and operations to explain why things happen, not just what . Through natural conversation, it helps users uncover inefficiencies and understand anomalies, anticipate issues, and evaluate actions that deliver the greatest impact on cost, uptime, and sustainability. With NODA CoPilot, advanced analytics are always at your fingertips - turning data into dialogue and insight into action. Learn more 20 + YEARS OF THERMAL EXCELLENCE 15000 + CONNECTED > 40 % THERMAL CAPACITY 3 MT ANNUAL CO2 CUT Serving the energy sector, with a particular focus on the complex thermal energy. | NODA has spent over two decades harnessing specifically the potential in thermal energy - the most complex form of energy to manage and accounting for 50% of global energy consumption. Our vision is to provide sustainable energy whenever and wherever it's needed. We are committed to driving positive change in the journey towards a greener future - making sustainability profitable, every building, every city, every time. NODA Our Vision By 2040, global energy demand is expected to increase by 21%, with heating and cooling consuming 50% of that energy—while 25% is still wasted. Incremental innovation won’t be enough; achieving true efficiency requires creating balance across the entire energy grid. NODA delivers cutting-edge software solutions that empower both consumers and producers in large-scale distributed thermal energy systems — minimizing waste while maintaining high service quality and environmental standards. Our patented technology and proven data- and AI-based software are being utilized by energy companies, service and system providers, as well as property owners across Europe, North America, and Asia. NODA Intelligent Platform and NODA Business Applications are helping to accelerate the shift towards significantly more efficient energy systems by increasing system capacity and reducing fossil dependence. NODA puts in context not only the data, but also the models processing it - training self-learning systems that adapt in real time. We've utilized AI agents long before the term was mainstream, empowering organizations and systems to make the right choice - always! Discover more Let us talk 4+ Technology Our Patented Software With over 20 years of experience, NODA Intelligent Systems offers industry-leading digital solutions in the thermal energy sector. Our journey, marked by numerous trials and learnings, has culminated in the development of the NODA Intelligent Platform, which powers our business applications to deliver exceptional value to end-users. In today's data-driven world, transforming information into tangible business outcomes is crucial. While many acknowledge this need, few consistently achieve it across every building, heat network, and city. The complexity lies in managing intricate workflows that integrate diverse data sources from both primary and secondary sides, as well as IoT networks. For instance, optimizing a district heating network may involve a 10-step process. Assuming a 97% success rate for each step, the compounded error rate could reach 26%, leading to potential failures in one out of every four workflow executions. Our solutions are designed to address these challenges, ensuring reliable and efficient optimization of thermal energy systems. Read more Request demo Learn more Need proof before you commit? | The NODA Pre-study is a low-risk, time-bound first step to understand and unlock the flexibility potential of your district heating network. Using your existing meter and operational data, we deliver a decision-ready report that quantifies available flexibility, identifies where it is located in the network and buildings, and estimates its economic value. The Pre-study also assesses data quality and clearly states what additional hardware, if any, would be required to improve data fidelity. No new hardware is required to get started, and any recommendations are strictly value-driven. In a recent pre-study with Umeå Energi AB , we transformed existing heat meter data into clear insights on where flexibility exists (in network and per building), what it’s worth (€/kr/$ savings), and how it supports a solid, data-driven business case - all in just two weeks. ‘Reducing peak loads in the district heating system is essential for long-term resilience and sustainability. The pre-study is an important first step in understanding where flexibility exists and how it can support system efficiency, climate goals, and profitability.’ - Mathias Nygren , Affärschef Umeå Energi. A safe starting point for data-driven flexibility and future-proof operations! Discover more Let us talk Energy Services The measurable results have transformed our business.
